verdict.rationale: First-party docs show BM25 keyword search built into Weaviate, running in parallel with vector search inside hybrid queries [weaviate-docs-1, weaviate-docs-14]. Weaviate also stores its own inverted indexes [weaviate-probe-1] and supports keyword-based search natively [weaviate-docs-22, weaviate-docs-26]. A community user contrasts this favorably with running a separate Elasticsearch cluster [weaviate-comm-1]. missing for 10: explicit docs for standalone (non-hybrid) BM25 queries, full-text configuration details (tokenization, phrase/fuzzy matching), independent hands-on evaluation of keyword search quality.
